files.scope: Rust files under src, tests, examples, and benches that are tracked or are non-ignored working-tree additions
files.measurement: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- src tests examples benches; keep paths ending in .rs; count physical lines with awk 'END { print NR + 0 }'

p90.method: nearest-rank percentile over ascending physical-line counts

functions.measurement: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings with clippy::too_many_lines denied and too-many-lines-threshold set in clippy.toml; the source-size gate rejects the too_many_lines identifier anywhere in Rust source so attributes cannot lower the lint
functions.exact_maximum_note: Clippy reliably rejects violations but does not report the largest compliant function, so no exact maximum was inferred with a text heuristic.

decisions.file_limit_basis: Required repository-wide source-size tripwire; every larger tracked or non-ignored new Rust file was split before this measurement.
decisions.function_limit_basis: Required explicit Clippy function tripwire on the pinned toolchain; the full target set passes it.
